description: This file contains a series of tests for various functions and adapters related to allowlist configuration management in a software project. It tests functions for reading and transforming allowlist entries, as well as creating adapters for managing allowlist policies for direct message and group accounts, both legacy and current implementations.

methods.name: readConfiguredAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Reads an array of allowlist entries, coercing mixed types to non-empty string representations.

methods.name: collectAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Collects non-empty allowlist entries from flat records.

methods.name: collectNestedAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Collects outer and nested allowlist entries from hierarchical records.

methods.name: createFlatAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for flat allowlist overrides based on an account record.

methods.name: createNestedAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for nested allowlist overrides based on a hierarchical account record.

methods.name: createAccountScopedAllowlistNameResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver that, given an account, resolves allowlist names based on a token.

methods.name: buildDmGroupAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter for managing allowlist policies for DM and group accounts, supporting reading and editing the configuration.

methods.name: buildLegacyDmAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds a legacy adapter for DM account allowlist policies, with support for reading legacy configs and applying edits.

ctags.name: scopeCases
ctags.pattern: /^  const scopeCases: Array<{ scope: "dm" | "group" | "all"; expected: boolean }> = [$/
